worldcombat.skill.nobleroar.summary: Plant your feet, throw the chest out, and let a low roar push a whole cone of sound forward. Everything in it is cowed: Attack and Sp. Atk drop together, and a narrower bellow presses harder.
worldcombat.skill.nobleroar.use.0: Stop a group charging straight at you
worldcombat.skill.nobleroar.use.1: Blunt the enemy's output before the first blow
worldcombat.skill.nobleroar.use.2: Catch a small cluster with one wide blast
Push a cone of sound forward; every enemy caught in it is counted once, losing %1$s stages of Attack and Sp. Atk so its physical and special hits land weaker. The pressure reaches %2$s blocks and opens %3$s degrees, and needs no line of sight.

Cowed targets also carry the "Cowed" marker for about %1$s; the marker only shows they were just roared at, while the real drop is the Attack and Sp. Atk stages, which stay until the stat ladder resets after a stretch out of combat.
Telegraph %1$s s, recovery %2$s s, cooldown %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.nobleroar.timing: The telegraph can be interrupted without paying anything; PP and cooldown settle only after commit.
worldcombat.skill.nobleroar.preference.f: Roar: angle x1.35, same length, only 1 stage dropped - good for covering a crowd. Low bellow: angle x0.62, length x1.15, 2 stages dropped - good for pressing one line hard.
worldcombat.skill.nobleroar.preference.a: Consider roaring when a threat is within this distance; larger commits earlier and risks roaring at nothing.
Only prefer the roar when at least this many enemies sit inside the cone; set 1 to roar on sight.
On: skip when everyone in the cone is already cowed, saving the roar for fresher targets. Off: keep roaring.
